known_failure_modes: NO dateFrom/dateTo on /omo: the ONLY bulk route is daily-year (one year per call). The 10,000-row silent cap documented on /fxrates/forward does NOT apply here because no year exceeds ~470 rows — but the per-year loop is mandatory and a missing year is silent.

lang=EN does NOT localise enum VALUES: operationType and liquidityImpact stay Czech ('Repo','Depozitni facilita','Lombardni facilita' / 'Stazeni','Dodani') even under lang=EN. A consumer filtering on English strings returns ZERO rows and reads it as 'no operations' (WS-005 shape).

INSTRUMENT-MIX CONTAMINATION (the finding): summing totalAllotedVolume per period is NOT a liquidity stock. The overnight deposit facility rolls ~252x/yr and the repo ~26x/yr, so the naive sum is 82% weighted to whichever instrument happens to be in use. When the CNB shifted sterilisation from the O/N facility to 14-day repos after the 2017-04 floor exit, the naive sum fell 27,431 -> 8,204 CZKbln (-70%) while the TRUE outstanding stock was FLAT at ~2,200. The obvious aggregation manufactures a 70% liquidity-drain signal at the single highest-attention moment in the series.

MONTH-END SAMPLING BIAS: 14-day repos mature at month-end and the replacement settles the next business day, so a month-end snapshot of the stock lands in the gap and reads ~20% low (2014-12: end 491 vs mean 613). Use the monthly MEAN of the daily stock, never the month-end value.
3 rows have maturityDate <= settlementDate and are dropped.

verification: Ground-truth diff vs the EURCZK 27.00 floor episode (2013-11-07 -> 2017-04-06): the reconstructed sterilisation stock steps 400.8 -> 600.0 CZKbln in the floor-announcement month (2013-11, +49.7% in one month, the largest one-month move in the pre-2017 series) and rises monotonically to 2,170 by the exit month. Mechanism confirmed on the known episode.
